prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1222; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text:
Treatment summary

The patient presented after a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck strain. The mechanism and force of the crash are consistent with the injury reported. Over eleven visits, care followed a typical course of conservative management, with symptoms and visit frequency tapering as the patient improved. Examination showed some findings that support a soft tissue injury to the cervical region, while other tests returned normal results. No prior injury to the neck or upper back is known from the history provided. On review of the billing record, one service appears twice for the same visit date. The treating provider acknowledged that the second entry was a repeat and should not have been submitted. Prognosis is good, with expected full recovery and no permanent impairment anticipated. Follow-up care is available as needed.
